title: Tilly Remembers Her Grandfather, Three Months On

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责报道《纽约时报》每日简报

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《Dealbook》的商业与政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些坦诚、未经删减的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上免费直播精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不会想错过。

sentences.en: Hey there, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: This week, we're revisiting people we met in the early weeks of the pandemic, listening back, and hearing what's happened to them since our original conversations.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将回访在大流行初期遇到的人们，重新聆听，并了解他们自从我们最初对话以来发生了什么。

sentences.en: Today, Tilly BrimhorSt. It's Friday, July 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天的主角是蒂莉·布里姆霍斯特。今天是7月17日，星期五。

sentences.en: Uh, I am recording, and it is working.
sentences.zh: 呃，我在录音了，而且正在运行。

sentences.en: Hey, Tilly?
sentences.zh: 嘿，蒂莉？

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hey, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm doing okay.
sentences.zh: 我挺好的。

sentences.en: Tilly, what is that in your hand?
sentences.zh: 蒂莉，你手里拿的是什么？

sentences.en: It looks like a blanket or a stuffed animal.
sentences.zh: 看起来像一条毯子或一个毛绒玩具。

sentences.en: It's a blanket.
sentences.zh: 是一条毯子。

sentences.en: Oh, what does it say on it?
sentences.zh: 哦，上面写着什么？

sentences.en: It says, powered by pizza.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，披萨能量驱动。

sentences.en: And does it look like it has an image of pepperoni pizza on it?
sentences.zh: 它看起来上面有意大利辣香肠披萨的图案吗？

sentences.en: Is that what I'm glimpsing?
sentences.zh: 我看到的是这个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Pepperoni.
sentences.zh: 辣香肠。

sentences.en: That's pretty great.
sentences.zh: 那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Um, well, Tilly, I really want to thank you for getting on the phone with us, or I guess this Google Hangout with us.
sentences.zh: 嗯，蒂莉，我真的很感谢你给我们打电话，或者说通过这个谷歌群聊跟我们通话。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you could tell me your full name, and how old you are.
sentences.zh: 我想请你告诉你的全名，还有你今年几岁。

sentences.en: Matilda Rose BrimhorSt.
sentences.zh: 玛蒂尔达·罗斯·布里姆霍斯特。
zh_words: 玛蒂尔达·罗斯·布里姆霍斯特

sentences.en: And then I am 12.
sentences.zh: 然后我12岁了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And I just want to start with a very simple question.
sentences.zh: 我想从一个非常简单的问题开始。

sentences.en: How have you been feeling this past week?
sentences.zh: 你过去这周感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Um, I'm kind of in and out of mood.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的情绪有点起伏不定。

sentences.en: Usually, the two moods that I'm mostly in are sad and angry.
sentences.zh: 通常我最常有的两种情绪是伤心和生气。

sentences.en: And why do you think that you're sad and angry?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你为什么会伤心和生气呢？

sentences.en: What about?
sentences.zh: 为了什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: We're, I feel like we're sad and angry, because I think angry more that it's not fair that he's gone.
sentences.zh: 我们，我觉得我们又伤心又生气，因为我觉得更生气的是他走了这很不公平。

sentences.en: And I feel like sad is really, we're sad that he's gone, and sad that we're being sad.
sentences.zh: 我觉得伤心是真的，我们既为他的离开感到伤心，也为我们自己感到伤心。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Tens of thousands of Americans have died from the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的美国人死于冠状病毒。

sentences.en: One of them was Craig BrimhorSt.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是克雷格·布里姆霍斯特。

sentences.en: Today, his granddaughter remembers him.
sentences.zh: 今天，他的孙女缅怀了他。

sentences.en: It's Friday, May 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月1日，星期五。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could tell me a little bit about your grandfather.
sentences.zh: 我想请你跟我多讲讲你的祖父。

sentences.en: How would you describe your grandfather physically?
sentences.zh: 从外表来看，你会怎么形容你的祖父？

sentences.en: What did he look like?
sentences.zh: 他长什么样？

sentences.en: What would he wear?
sentences.zh: 他会穿什么样的衣服？诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Well, he'd wear pastor clothes and stuff.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他会穿牧师的衣服之类的。

sentences.en: Was he a pastor?
sentences.zh: 他是个牧师吗？

sentences.en: Yes, he was a pastor.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是个牧师。

sentences.en: He used to be a mailman, and then he didn't really like that job.
sentences.zh: 他以前是个邮递员，后来他其实不太喜欢那份工作。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 唔。

sentences.en: And he had, like, white hair, and then the mustache that goes right into the beard.
sentences.zh: 他有那种白头发，还有一直连到胡子里的髭须。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And when I was little, I played with his beard, because it just felt so interesting touching it with my hands.
sentences.zh: 我小的时候，会玩他的胡子，因为用手去摸感觉太有趣了。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: It felt all rough and scrapey, but, like, not too scrapey.
sentences.zh: 感觉很粗糙、有点扎人，但又不是特别扎人。

sentences.en: He'd wear glasses, and sometimes I stole his glasses, and he's like, Joey, bring him back.
sentences.zh: 他会戴眼镜，有时我会偷他的眼镜，然后他就说，乔伊，把它还给我。

sentences.en: And, like, whenever I walked into the house, he'd just be like, ho-dee-ho.
sentences.zh: 而且，每当我走进屋子，他就会说，噢迪噢。

sentences.en: I don't know where that came from, but just, it's always something he said.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这个词是从哪里来的，但这总是他会说的话。

sentences.en: Ho-dee-ho.
sentences.zh: 噢迪噢。

sentences.en: Ho-dee-ho.
sentences.zh: 噢迪噢。

sentences.en: It's more interesting than, hello.
sentences.zh: 这比说“你好”有趣多了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Did he have any kind of nickname for you?
sentences.zh: 他有没有给你起过什么昵称？

sentences.en: Tilly B was my one.
sentences.zh: 蒂莉·B 是我的昵称。

sentences.en: Tilly B.
sentences.zh: 蒂莉·B。

sentences.en: Yeah, because for Brian Forrest, they just called me Tilly B, and it kind of just rhymes.
sentences.zh: 对，因为对于布里姆霍斯特，他们就叫我蒂莉·B，这听起来有点押韵。

sentences.en: Wait, which part rhymes?
sentences.zh: 等等，哪一部分押韵？

sentences.en: Tilly, and then B.
sentences.zh: 蒂莉，还有 B。

sentences.en: It's just kind of, like, it just goes together.
sentences.zh: 就感觉像是，它们自然而然地组合在了一起。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 唔。

sentences.en: Tilly B.
sentences.zh: 蒂莉·B。

sentences.en: Tilly B.
sentences.zh: 蒂莉·B。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He'd always make me happy.
sentences.zh: 他总是能让我开心。

sentences.en: I'd never, like, really get upset around him unless I was hurt.
sentences.zh: 在他身边我从来不会真正难过，除非我受伤了。

sentences.en: Unless you were hurt, you said?
sentences.zh: 你说除非你受伤了？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because we did all sorts of crazy things.
sentences.zh: 因为我们做过各种各样疯狂的事情。

sentences.en: Wait, now I need to understand some of the crazy things you did with him.
sentences.zh: 等等，现在我得了解一下你跟他一起做过的一些疯狂事情。

sentences.en: Um, well, he'd take me out on the roof once we brought sleeping bags on the roof.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他会带我到屋顶上，有一次我们把睡袋带到了屋顶上。

sentences.en: The roof of your house?
sentences.zh: 你家的屋顶？

sentences.en: Uh, no, my grandpa's house.
sentences.zh: 呃，不是，是我爷爷的房子。

sentences.en: But we didn't tell my dad about it until afterwards.
sentences.zh: 但我们直到事后才告诉我爸爸。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It sounds like he has a slightly mischievous quality to him.
sentences.zh: 听起来他有一点调皮的特质。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about that?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我讲讲吗？

sentences.en: What was that like?
sentences.zh: 那是怎样的体验？

sentences.en: Well, it would usually be, like, the middle of summer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，通常会在盛夏的半夜。

sentences.en: And we'd grab the stepladder and open the window, pull up the screen, climb up onto the edge of the roof, up to our special spot, just laid there on the roof.
sentences.zh: 我们会拿来人字梯，打开窗户，拉起纱窗，爬到屋顶边缘，来到我们的特殊秘密基地，就躺在屋顶上。

sentences.en: And we'd just look at the stars and talk for a while.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就看着星星聊上一会儿。

sentences.en: What kinds of things would your grandfather say?
sentences.zh: 你爷爷会说些什么样的话？

sentences.en: Um, here, Tilly, let's look for the Big Dipper, maybe the Milky Way if we're lucky.
sentences.zh: 嗯，来吧，蒂莉，我们找找北斗七星，运气好的话还能找到银河。

sentences.en: And Mars might be like, wait, but isn't Mars a planet, not a star?
sentences.zh: 还有火星可能会像，等等，但火星不是行星吗，不是恒星？

sentences.en: You would just be like, but we can see it as a red star, kind of.
sentences.zh: 他就会说，但我们差不多可以把它看作一颗红色的星星。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: The stars were really bright, and it was really warm outside, and it was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 星星非常亮，外面很暖和，而且非常美丽。

sentences.en: How often would you see your grandfather?
sentences.zh: 你多久见一次你爷爷？

sentences.en: We wouldn't see him, like, every single weekend.
sentences.zh: 我们不是每个周末都能见到他。

sentences.en: But, like, we'd see him a lot.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们会经常见面。

sentences.en: He'd, like, come to my school, and he'd sit in the lunchroom with me.
sentences.zh: 他会来我的学校，和我一起坐在餐厅里吃午饭。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He would just show up?
sentences.zh: 他就这样出现了？

sentences.en: Did he announce himself?
sentences.zh: 他提前打招呼了吗？

sentences.en: Was it unexpected?
sentences.zh: 这是意料之外的吗？

sentences.en: He would never tell me that he was coming.
sentences.zh: 他从来不告诉我他要来。

sentences.en: And he'd just be waiting for me right next to the lunchroom door, just waiting for me.
sentences.zh: 他就一直在餐厅门外等我，一直在那儿等着我。

sentences.en: And then I'd just look around for him every time.
sentences.zh: 然后每次我都会到处找他。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: He'd sit right next to me, and I'd have my lunchbox, and he'd kind of just pick out things from it.
sentences.zh: 他就坐在我旁边，我拿着饭盒，他就会从里面挑点东西吃。

sentences.en: Sometimes he'd take my chips, and I'd be like, Papa!
sentences.zh: 有时他会拿我的薯片，我就说，爸爸！

sentences.en: He'd talk to my friends.
sentences.zh: 他会和我的朋友们聊天。

sentences.en: He'd talk about, like, all these fun things, like, all his stories about, like, going to
sentences.zh: 他会谈论所有这些有趣的事情，比如他去

sentences.en: Tanzania, and all sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 坦桑尼亚旅行的故事，以及各种各样的趣事。

sentences.en: And what would you think when you saw him?
sentences.zh: 当你看到他时，你心里在想什么？

sentences.en: Um, I think I'd be proud.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我会感到骄傲。

sentences.en: I'd be proud that my grandpa comes to this, to my school a lot, to just eat lunch with me and tell my friends all these stories.
sentences.zh: 我会为我的爷爷经常来学校陪我吃午饭、给我的朋友们讲这些故事而感到骄傲。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: He was just there, right when I needed it, which made me feel really nice.
sentences.zh: 他就在那里，正当我需要他的时候出现，这让我感觉非常美好。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know a lot of grandpas or grandmas who do that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不知道有多少爷爷奶奶会这样做。

sentences.en: It's really special.
sentences.zh: 这真的很特别。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, I want you to tell me, if you're willing, the story of the last few weeks and what happened with your grandfather.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你愿意的话，我想请你讲讲过去几周的故事，以及你爷爷身上发生了什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And I wonder, I don't know where you think we should start.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你觉得我们该从哪里开始呢。

sentences.en: Uh, I think we should, like, start from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 呃，我觉得我们应该从头开始讲。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So, Papa and my grandma went to the Holy Lands.
sentences.zh: 所以，爸爸和我奶奶去了圣地。

sentences.en: He wanted to take his church group there.
sentences.zh: 他想带他的教会团体去那里。

sentences.en: So, they went to the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以他们去了中东。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Where baby Jesus was, like, born, and, like, that's sort of the place.
sentences.zh: 就是婴儿耶稣出生的地方，大概就是那个地方。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And then they got, like, this morning there.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在那里待到了某个早晨。

sentences.en: An outbreak has started here of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 这里爆发了冠状病毒疫情。

sentences.en: And so, when they come back, they were straight into quarantine.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们回来时，直接就被隔离了。

sentences.en: But right when they came back, Papa started getting, like, really ill.
sentences.zh: 但就在他们回来后，爸爸开始变得真的很不舒服。

sentences.en: He had high fever.
sentences.zh: 他高烧不退。

sentences.en: Really high fever.
sentences.zh: 高烧得非常厉害。

sentences.en: And in my mind, at first, when he was home, I was like, oh, he's fine.
sentences.zh: 起初在我脑海里，当他回到家时，我想，哦，他没事。

sentences.en: He'll get through this.
sentences.zh: 他会挺过去的。

sentences.en: He's strong.
sentences.zh: 他很坚强。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But then he got worse and worse.
sentences.zh: 但后来他的情况越来越糟。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, no, it's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 当时我就觉得，哦，不，事情要发生了。

sentences.en: And I was just kind of in a worried state.
sentences.zh: 我整个人就处于一种担忧的状态。

sentences.en: But, like, not like a, oh, my gosh, I'm really, really sad, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 但也不是那种，天哪，我真的、真的很伤心之类的感觉。

sentences.en: And until, like, a couple weeks later, he just couldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 直到大约几周后，他实在撑不下去了。

sentences.en: And he got lifted to the hospital here.
sentences.zh: 然后他被转送到这里的医院。

sentences.en: And, Tilly, were you talking to him during this time?
sentences.zh: 蒂莉，这段时间你有跟他说话吗？

sentences.en: No, I didn't get to talk to him at all.
sentences.zh: 没有，我完全没能跟他说话。

sentences.en: I mean, he sent him, like, letters, but I don't know if he even got to read those.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他寄过信，但我不知道他甚至有没有看那些信。

sentences.en: I remember, so, when I heard about that he was put in the hospital, because it got worse.
sentences.zh: 我记得，当听说他因为病情恶化被送进医院时……

sentences.en: Mom was like, do you want to sleep with one of his shirts?
sentences.zh: 妈妈问我：你想抱着他的衬衫睡觉吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I was like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我说：好啊。

sentences.en: So, she brought me this shirt.
sentences.zh: 于是她把这件衬衫拿给了我。

sentences.en: It was just, like, a greenish-brown T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 它就是一件绿褐色相间的T恤。

sentences.en: Were you wearing it, or was it just beside you?
sentences.zh: 你是穿着它，还是只是放在身边？

sentences.en: I was wearing it.
sentences.zh: 我穿着它。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It felt, like, really, really big on me.
sentences.zh: 穿在我身上感觉真的、真的好大。

sentences.en: Um, it was kind of, like, cold, but it felt really soothing to wear it, though.
sentences.zh: 嗯，感觉有点凉，但穿着它让人觉得非常安心。

sentences.en: I wanted to feel like I was close to him.
sentences.zh: 我想感受一下离他很近的感觉。

sentences.en: I was giving him a hug, and I thought about him the whole night.
sentences.zh: 我抱着它，那一整晚都在想他。

sentences.en: I prayed that he would make it through, that he wouldn't have to go.
sentences.zh: 我祈祷他能挺过来，不用离开。

sentences.en: My prayer really didn't come true.
sentences.zh: 我的祈祷最终没有成真。

sentences.en: Because he had a stroke during the night from a heart disease that he had.
sentences.zh: 因为他因自身的心脏病，在夜里突发中风。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And that made it super worse.
sentences.zh: 这让情况变得糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: And even if we did get him back, he wouldn't actually, like, his body would be there, but he wouldn't be there.
sentences.zh: 而且就算我们真的把他救回来了，实际上他——他的身体会在那儿，但人已经不在了。

sentences.en: He couldn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 他什么也做不了。

sentences.en: Like, he couldn't talk into the things that made him him.
sentences.zh: 比如说，他无法再表达那些构成他特质的东西。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And how did you learn the news?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么得知这个消息的？

sentences.en: Mom got a call, and then I looked at her, and I saw worry, so I kind of just, um, just did stuff.
sentences.zh: 妈妈接了个电话，然后我看着她，从她脸上看到了担忧，所以我就……嗯，就做我自己的事。

sentences.en: And then Mommy told me what happened.
sentences.zh: 然后妈妈把发生的事情告诉了我。

sentences.en: And what did she tell you?
sentences.zh: 她对你说了什么？

sentences.en: She told me about the living will that my grandma, my dad, and my uncles read it.
sentences.zh: 她跟我讲了生前预嘱的事，我奶奶、我爸爸和我的叔叔们都读过它。

sentences.en: Well, the doctor read it to them, that it said that if something happened, he wanted to go.
sentences.zh: 哦，医生读给他们听的，上面说如果发生什么意外，他希望能离开。

sentences.en: He didn't want to, like, have to suffer in this state.
sentences.zh: 他不想在这种状态下受苦。

sentences.en: So, your grandfather had written a will that made clear that if he got very sick,
sentences.zh: 所以，你外公曾写下一份遗嘱，明确表示如果他病得很重，

sentences.en: and he'd reached a condition where things weren't working out, that he wanted to be allowed to die.
sentences.zh: 并且病情恶化到无法挽回的地步时，他希望能够安乐死。

sentences.en: Yeah, and he just wanted to go to heaven and be with God.
sentences.zh: 对，他只想去天堂和上帝在一起。

sentences.en: Like, he says, he wanted to fall in the arms of God.
sentences.zh: 就像他说的，他想投入上帝的怀抱。

sentences.en: That's what he wrote.
sentences.zh: 他是这么写的。

sentences.en: Yeah, he wants to fall in the arms of God.
sentences.zh: 对，他想投入上帝的怀抱。

sentences.en: He's like a trust fall, really.
sentences.zh: 真的就像在玩信任倒（Trust Fall）一样。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And I couldn't handle, like, knowing that.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法接受这个事实。

sentences.en: I knew that he wouldn't be coming back.
sentences.zh: 我知道他再也不会回来了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And that was hard to know.
sentences.zh: 这很难接受。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: How are you holding up over there?
sentences.zh: 你在那边情况怎么样？

sentences.en: Um, I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我还好。

sentences.en: Um, it's hard talking about it, but it also makes me happy to talk about how great he was and what happened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谈论这些很难，但一想到他有多棒以及过去的事，也让我感到开心。

sentences.en: You know, I've lost my grandparents, too.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我也失去过祖父母。

sentences.en: It's one of the kind of sad, inevitable things that it means to be alive is that the people before you die, and it's just really hard.
sentences.zh: 这是生命中某种悲伤但不可避免的事情，意味着你生命中的长辈会离去，这真的很难面对。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is really hard.
sentences.zh: 是的，真的很艰难。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I want you to know you're being very brave in telling the story.
sentences.zh: 我想让你知道，你在讲述这个故事时非常勇敢。

sentences.en: I know how difficult it must be.
sentences.zh: 我知道这一定很难。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，今天就下载《时报》应用，即可获得30天免费使用权。

sentences.en: Can I ask you to describe sadness to me?
sentences.zh: 我能请你向我描述一下悲伤吗？

sentences.en: What that feels like?
sentences.zh: 那种感觉是怎样的？

sentences.en: I feel like it's hard.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很难。

sentences.en: Sadness is probably like a hard one for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，悲伤可能是一个很难说清楚的概念。

sentences.en: Happiness, I could do easily.
sentences.zh: 快乐的话，我可以轻易做到。

sentences.en: But like, sadness is kind of hard.
sentences.zh: 但悲伤有点难。

sentences.en: Why is happiness easy and why is sadness hard, do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得为什么快乐很简单，而悲伤很难呢？

sentences.en: Um, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, sadness is an emotion that is kind of like more like deeper and it's kind of like a big, big emotion.
sentences.zh: 我是说，悲伤是一种更深沉的情感，它有点像一种巨大无比的情感。

sentences.en: Happiness can be big, but not as much as sadness.
sentences.zh: 快乐也可以很大，但不如悲伤那么强烈。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: There's a depth to it that makes it hard to describe.
sentences.zh: 它有一种深邃感，让人难以描述。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I just kind of feel like sadness is like just an ocean filled with nothing.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得悲伤就像一片空无一物的海洋。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Have you noticed that the people around you, your parents, that they are sad too?
sentences.zh: 你有没有发现你身边的人，比如你的父母，他们也很伤心？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, my dad will go outside a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以，我爸爸经常会去外面。

sentences.en: You can tell that he's getting angry and he's really short-tempered.
sentences.zh: 你能看出他开始生气了，而且脾气变得很急躁。

sentences.en: At that point, mom will kind of just stay in her office, not really doing anything.
sentences.zh: 到了那个时候，妈妈就会呆在她的办公室里，什么也不做。

sentences.en: But she'll just sit around.
sentences.zh: 她就只是坐在那里。

sentences.en: And like, I've seen mom try to keep crying to herself and dad too, but I can see it.
sentences.zh: 而且，我看到妈妈试图背着我偷偷哭泣，爸爸也是，但我能看出来。

sentences.en: You mean try to, they're trying to shield it from you?
sentences.zh: 你是说他们试图对你隐瞒？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I can still feel it.
sentences.zh: 但我依然能感觉到。

sentences.en: Do you wish that they would just do it in front of you?
sentences.zh: 你希望他们直接在你面前哭吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And why do you think they should do it more out in the open?
sentences.zh: 你为什么觉得他们应该更公开地表现出来呢？

sentences.en: I kind of feel like I can, it helps me understand my emotions as well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这样也能帮我理解自己的情绪。

sentences.en: Like, how they feel.
sentences.zh: 比如他们的感受。

sentences.en: Do I feel that?
sentences.zh: 我是不是也有这种感受？

sentences.en: It kind of gives you permission to feel the way you feel.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上赋予了你感受当下情绪的权利。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like, when I was talking to my dad about Papa, he started crying and I started crying and then we just hugged and it was nice.
sentences.zh: 比如，当我和爸爸谈论外公时，他哭了，我也哭了，然后我们紧紧拥抱在一起，那种感觉很好。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of kids are going through what you're going through right now because of this virus.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为这场病毒，许多孩子正在经历你所经历的一切。

sentences.en: And a lot of adults are going through this.
sentences.zh: 许多成年人也正在经历这些。

sentences.en: I wonder how that makes you feel.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这带给你什么样的感受。

sentences.en: It makes me feel, like, not alone and it also kind of makes me feel a bit angry about how they still haven't figured out how this started.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得我并不孤单，同时对于他们到现在还没弄清楚这到底是怎么开始的，我也感到有点生气。

sentences.en: I want to know so I could figure out, like, how it wouldn't happen again.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，这样我才能明白以后怎么才能避免它再次发生。

sentences.en: Like, was it a cause of a human that did it?
sentences.zh: 比如，这是人类引起的吗？

sentences.en: Was it a cause of an animal?
sentences.zh: 是动物引起的吗？

sentences.en: Was it kind of both?
sentences.zh: 还是两者都有？

sentences.en: And if it turns out this is just something that nature and the universe gave us and it wasn't somebody who did something, how would you feel about that?
sentences.zh: 如果结果证明这只是大自然和宇宙带给我们的，而不是某个人做了什么导致的，你对此会有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I'd be mad at the universe.
sentences.zh: 我会对宇宙生气的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I know that a lot of people, when someone they care about or they love passes away,
sentences.zh: 我知道很多人在他们关心或爱的人去世时，

sentences.en: they end up looking for that person in the world or they end up thinking about that person unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 最终会在世界上寻找那个人的身影，或者会在意料之外的时候想起那个人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And thinking that maybe they're there or they're standing by you, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 并且觉得也许他们就在附近，或者正站在你身边，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Yeah, I feel like Papa was, like, by me a lot.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得外公经常陪在我身边。

sentences.en: But sometimes I feel like he's out there, like, with other people and helping them through their bad moments.
sentences.zh: 但有时我觉得他在外面，和别的人在一起，帮助他们度过糟糕的时刻。

sentences.en: You know, I have a very specific sense of my grandmother whenever this song comes on, because when I was around your age, she died.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，每当这首歌响起时，我对奶奶就会有一种非常深刻的感觉，因为在我大概你这个年纪时，她去世了。

sentences.en: And a song was playing on the radio, and it was a song that made me feel sad, even though it was a love song.
sentences.zh: 当时收音机里正播着一首歌，那首歌让我感到悲伤，尽管它是一首情歌。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've ever heard this song.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有听过这首歌。

sentences.en: It's by Richard Barks, and it goes, wherever you go, whatever you do, I will be right there waiting for you.
sentences.zh: 这是理查德·马克思（Richard Marx）唱的，歌词是：无论你走到哪里，无论你做什么，我都会在那里守候着你。

sentences.en: And it always makes me think of my grandmother and her death whenever it comes on.
sentences.zh: 每当这首歌响起，总是让我想起我的奶奶以及她的离去。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you're having moments like that yet.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否也有过这样的时刻。

sentences.en: Yeah, I do have those type of moments, but, like, kind of different than just a song.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实有过这样的时刻，但跟单纯的一首歌有点不太一样。

sentences.en: And it's more of when I saw my grandma in her backyard, because we went over just to the backyard.
sentences.zh: 更多时候是在我看到奶奶在她的后院时，因为我们只是过去后院。

sentences.en: We weren't allowed to get close to anyone, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我们不允许靠近任何人。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I felt like sad, but I also felt kind of relieved that he is in peace now.
sentences.zh: 我感到难过，但也感到一种释怀，因为他现在平静了。

sentences.en: He didn't have to deal with this bad virus.
sentences.zh: 他不必再去对付这个可怕的病毒。

sentences.en: He doesn't have to feel pain or sadness or anything.
sentences.zh: 他不必再感受痛苦、悲伤或任何其他情绪。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Tilly, have you gone outside and looked up at the stars since your grandfather died?
sentences.zh: 蒂莉，自从你外公去世后，你有去外面抬头看过星星吗？

sentences.en: Um, only a little bit, but not much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，只看过一点点，但不多。

sentences.en: It's not the same without being at my grandma's house.
sentences.zh: 不在奶奶家的话，感觉就不一样了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Do you think that you will do that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你会去看吗？

sentences.en: Do you think there'll be a point when you'll want to do that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得会有那么一个时刻，你想去看星星吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 会的。

sentences.en: That we said when we're going to go over to grandma's house, um, me, daddy, and my big sister are going to go up onto the roof and just sit there looking at the stars.
sentences.zh: 我们说过，等我们去奶奶家的时候，嗯，我和爸爸还有大姐会去屋顶上，坐在那里看星星。

sentences.en: Mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, Tilly, I really want to thank you for spending time with us, and I want to tell you I'm sorry I am about the loss of your grandfather.
sentences.zh: 蒂莉，我真的很感谢你抽空和我们聊天，我也想对你外公的离去表达我的哀悼。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: It was really good to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 能跟你聊聊真的很好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It feels good to talk to someone about it.
sentences.zh: 能跟别人聊聊这个感觉真好。

sentences.en: It's good to talk.
sentences.zh: 聊聊挺好的。

sentences.en: After this episode aired, Tilly began receiving letters from people across the country.
sentences.zh: 这集节目播出后，蒂莉开始收到来自全国各地人们的信件。

sentences.en: Some knew her grandfather and wanted to share stories of their time with him.
sentences.zh: 有些人认识她的祖父，想分享他们跟他在一起时的故事。

sentences.en: Others wanted to tell her about their own treasured relationship with a grandparent.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则想告诉她，他们自己与祖父母之间珍贵的感情。

sentences.en: One listener, Lee Goldman, wrote, quote,
sentences.zh: 其中一位听众李·戈德曼写道，引述：

sentences.en: Tilly says it's been a while since her grandfather has appeared in her dreams and that she's recently stopped wearing his shirt when she goes to bed.
sentences.zh: 蒂莉说，她的祖父已经有一段时间没有出现在她的梦里了，而且她最近睡觉时也不再穿着他的衬衫了。

sentences.en: Tilly is spending her summer playing with her cousins and visiting places she used to go with her grandfather, like the nature center near his house.
sentences.zh: 蒂莉这个夏天一直在和表亲们玩耍，并去她以前常和祖父一起去的地方，比如他家附近的自然中心。

sentences.en: She's also been running through sprinklers, going to the pool, and playing lots of Minecraft with her friends.
sentences.zh: 她还一直在草坪喷水器中奔跑、去游泳池，并和朋友们玩了大量的《我的世界》。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四，美国

sentences.en: and Canada said that Russian hackers are trying to steal coronavirus vaccine research from Western health organizations.
sentences.zh: 和加拿大表示，俄罗斯黑客正试图从西方卫生机构窃取冠状病毒疫苗研究成果。

sentences.en: The National Security Agency said that a hacking group associated with Russian intelligence is behind the attacks, which have employed phishing and malware scaMs.
sentences.zh: 国家安全局表示，一个与俄罗斯情报部门有关联的黑客组织是这些攻击的幕后黑手，这些攻击采用了网络钓鱼和恶意软件诈骗。

sentences.en: The hacking group, known as Cozy Bear, is well known to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这个被称为“舒适熊”的黑客组织在美国广为人知，

sentences.en: because it was implicated in the 2016 hacking of the Democratic National Committee.
sentences.zh: 因为它曾涉嫌参与2016年美国民主党全国委员会的黑客攻击事件。

sentences.en: And requirements to wear masks from state governments and private industry are spreading across the country.
sentences.zh: 此外，州政府和私营企业关于佩戴口罩的要求正在全国范围内蔓延。

sentences.en: The bottom line is that, like all Coloradans,
sentences.zh: 最底线是，就像所有科罗拉多州人一样，

sentences.en: I want to be able to enjoy life and go to a restaurant and get a haircut and keep our businesses open and protect our economy and protect lives.
sentences.zh: 我希望能享受生活，去餐厅，理发，保持我们企业的开业，保护我们的经济，并保护生命。

sentences.en: And the data increasingly shows that one of the powerful tools that we as a state have done well on but can do better on is wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 而且数据越来越多地表明，我们作为一个州做得不错、但还可以做得更好的强有力工具之一，就是佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: And that's why today I'm signing an executive order that's effective at midnight tonight that requires that every Coloradan age 10 and up wear a mask or face covering.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么今天我签署了一项行政命令，从今晚午夜起生效，要求每位10岁及以上的科罗拉多州人佩戴口罩或面部遮盖物。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the governors of Colorado and Arkansas issued statewide mask requirements for public indoor spaces.
sentences.zh: 周四，科罗拉多州和阿肯色州的州长发布了针对公共室内场所的全州口罩要求。

sentences.en: At the same time, Target and CVS issued their own mask requirements for customers, joining Walmart, Kroger, and Kohl's.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，塔吉特和CVS发布了针对顾客的自家口罩要求，加入了沃尔玛、克罗格和科尔士的行列。

sentences.en: As of Thursday night, there have been 3.5 million infections in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 截至周四晚，美国已有350万例感染病例。

sentences.en: Daily is made by
sentences.zh: 本节目由

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Sam Dolnick, Michaela Bouchard, Lauren Jackson, Julia Simon, Mahima Chablani, Nora Keller, and Caitlin Dickerson.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢山姆·多尔尼克、米凯拉·布夏、劳伦·杰克逊、朱莉娅·西蒙、马希马·查布拉尼、诺拉·凯勒和凯特琳·迪克森。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人家一般温馨的技巧。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是沾床就睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢收听的任何地方寻找《Wirecutter秀》。
